title: Payout Holds on Northloop Payments Accounts
content:
**Rule.** Payouts are held when the seller's performance standing is suspended (reason: account suspended), when the bank returns a payout (reason: bank details invalid), or when re-verification is overdue (reason: re-verification overdue). An account-suspended hold is released when the standing is reinstated, or after the suspension fund hold days counted from the suspension date if the standing is deactivated, the balance then being paid out in a final payout. A bank-details-invalid hold is released once new bank details are verified, and the returned payout is re-sent within the resend business days. A re-verification-overdue hold is released once re-verification completes. Sale credits, reserves, fees and debits continue to be booked during a hold.

## Hold reasons and their release

| Hold reason | Placed when | Released when |
|---|---|---|
| account suspended | the seller's performance standing is suspended | the standing is reinstated; or, if the standing is deactivated, after the suspension fund hold days counted from the suspension date, the balance then being paid out in a final payout |
| bank details invalid | the bank returns a payout | new bank details are verified; the returned payout is re-sent within the plan's resend business days |
| re-verification overdue | re-verification is overdue | re-verification completes |

## Account state

A held Northloop Payments account is on hold; when the hold cause is cleared, the support agent returns it to active and payouts resume. While the account is on hold, sale credits, reserves, fees and debits are still booked to it.

*Hypothetical reading.* A seller whose standing was deactivated after a suspension on day S, on a plan with 90 suspension fund hold days, has the account-suspended hold released after 90 calendar days counted from day S, and the balance is then paid out in a final payout.
